description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.16.3 is a bug-fix release for macOS and Windows on top of 0.16.2.
Bug fixes
- Runner reopens after a Windows update. After Install and restart, the updated Runner closed again before showing a window, so the update looked as if it had not restarted the app. Runner now waits for the previous background service to exit before replacing it, and moves aside a runner command that is still running. The same fix applies when the installer's Launch Runner opens a new version while the old background service is still running. (#908, #913, #922)
- Runner says why it cannot start. If Runner cannot start its background service, it records the reason in runner.log and, on Windows, shows it in a Runner could not start dialog instead of closing without a message. (#908, #922)
- The agent update dot clears after you update an agent outside Runner. Opening Usage or Settings → Agents now checks the installed agent CLI versions again, so the dot on the Usage popover's Agent settings gear goes away once every enabled agent is up to date. Its tooltip now reads Agent CLI update available, to set it apart from Runner's own updates. (#914, #919)
